description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

cards.heading: Soulcentric Photography
cards.text: It is less about perfect posing and more about presence. Less about constructing an image of who you should be and more about revealing something true.

cards.heading: Portrait Medicine
cards.text: Within intimate portrait work, the camera becomes a mirror, the photograph becomes an artifact, and being witnessed becomes an opportunity to meet yourself differently.
